# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old by the end of Volume 2  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Fred Wright  <sub>[v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016)</sub>
- **Rank:** Student; Treasurer of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, rosy cheeks, and long, glossy black hair. She has a plump figure with sweet dimples in her cheeks, which she occasionally worries will turn into stoutness as she grows older. She dresses with notable taste and wears her hair in stylish fashions.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v2 c29 P30](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0030), [v1 c19 P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034), [v1 c33 P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013)_

## Personality

Diana is cheerful, good-tempered, and highly practical, often serving as a sensible counterweight to Anne's vivid, romantic imagination. Although she lacks Anne's intense imaginative flights, she is an affectionate, loyal, and devoted companion. She loves reading and playing games, though she can be timid about anything dangerous or superstitious. She possesses a merry disposition and enjoys simple pleasures, social gatherings, and fun with her peers.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c15 P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v2 c2 P9](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0009), [v2 c18 P40](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0040)_

## Goals

- To be Anne Shirley's devoted bosom friend for life  <sub>[v1 c12 P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c17 P9](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0009)</sub>
- To prepare her trousseau and fancy work for her eventual marriage to Fred Wright  <sub>[v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024)</sub>

## History

Upon returning home from a visit to Carmody, Diana met Anne Shirley and the two girls solemnly swore an oath of eternal friendship in the Barry garden. Shortly after, Diana accidentally became intoxicated at Green Gables when Anne unknowingly served her currant wine instead of raspberry cordial, causing Mrs. Barry to strictly forbid Diana from playing with Anne. However, when her little sister Minnie May fell gravely ill with croup during her parents' absence, Anne saved the child's life, prompting Mrs. Barry to forgive Anne and restore the girls' friendship. Together with Anne, Diana joined the Avonlea school, participated in schoolhouse plays, the Debating Club concert, and the story club, and helped found the Avonlea Village Improvement Society as its treasurer. Although she did not join the Queen's class to pursue a teaching career, she remained Anne's constant confidante and supported her during her examinations and college preparations. During their late teens, Diana became romantically involved with Fred Wright, eventually becoming engaged to him.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P23](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0023), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c16 P23](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0023), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c16 P49](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0049), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 c29 P16](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0016)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea as the eldest daughter of George and Mrs. Barry  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>
- Raised under strict parental discipline, particularly by her resolute mother  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P14](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0014)</sub>
